helpStep1.message: Sign in with your Pseudora account.

helpStep2.message: Open ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini and write as usual.

helpStep3.message: With “Protect sending” on, press Enter: Pseudora replaces names, tax IDs, IBANs and emails before the text leaves.

helpStep4.message: The Pseudora button next to the field shows the status and opens the panel with what was replaced.

helpStep5.message: “Restore original” puts the text with personal data back in the field.

helpMore.message: Full guide and privacy notice at

shortcutUnsupportedSite.message: This shortcut works on ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini.
